P2CF2.wording: On every change of the component's binding (matchId, roomCode, role or campaignId) and before the new transport opens, reset the host fold to `EMPTY_CAMPAIGN_AUTHORITATIVE_FOLD` and the guest mirror through `beginMirror(peers, localPeerId)`, so the join quotes no stale cursor and the first baseline is adopted from EMPTY. This is P2CF2's sole production-visible behaviour change (registration review note 6): record it in the admission receipt and prove it in `CampaignCoopRouteSurfaceConnected.hostProjection.test.tsx` (a `roomCode` change without unmount must not keep `hostFold`).

At both frame handlers, before `setLastRefusalCode`/`setLastRefusalAction`, return early for any `Error` whose `reason?.startsWith('campaign-application-')`; no such reason may set `lastRefusalCode` or gate GM controls. Treat every transport `onError` whose message starts with `Campaign application recovery required:` (application-refused, application-failed, prefix-conflict, pending-overflow, send-failed) and every socket close as an automatic, idempotent rejoin: close the transport, reset fold/mirror per CF1, reconnect and adopt the new baseline as a replacement. Do not surface these as user-facing refusals.

A baseline offer (`appliedView.previousReceiptId === null`) is adopted with `replacement = true`: `foldCampaignHydration(fold, frame.event, frame.hydrationFacts, true, 0)` for the host, `applySnapshot(frame.event, 0, true, frame.hydrationFacts)` for the guest. Never pass `undefined` for `hydrationFacts` on an offered baseline, and never use the non-replacement path for a new view. A `null` result is `confirmApplied(offer, { status: 'failed', reason: 'fold-rejected' })` and sends no ACK. Track the view's `viewId` with the held fold so a baseline of another view is recognised as a replacement, not as a conflict.

`onAppliedViewConfirmed` is cumulative and at-least-once: a confirmation naming receipt R covers every earlier receipt of the same `viewId`; duplicates occur; an ACK superseded by a later offer before its confirmation arrived, and a rebaseline whose cut the stored row already covers, receive no confirmation at all. Never block UI, persistence or progression on a per-ACK confirmation; never wait after a rebaseline ACK.

Before `confirmApplied(offer, { status: 'applied' })`: for a baseline offer, the fold/mirror result's `launchFacts` must deep-equal `frame.hydrationFacts`; for a `CampaignMissionLaunched` offer, the result's `launchFacts` must end with `frame.event`; otherwise report `adjunct-failed`. Launch facts live only in the fold and the mirror store (in memory); the persistence store must not write `launchFacts` into the saved campaign record, and the staged maxima prepare ignores them.
Call `confirmApplied` in receipt order and exactly once per offer; the transport ACKs only `latest` once the whole pending prefix is applied, which is the cumulative ACK the server expects.

hardPreconditions.wording: Before `applicationReceipts` is composed into `bindCampaignSyncConnection` and `expectedCampaignId` is bound at every creator (CampaignCoopEntryPanel.tsx 328, CampaignCoopRouteSurfaceConnected.tsx 156 and 268, launch.tsx), close M1 by one of: (a) the client ignores `campaign-application-unknown-receipt` when a newer offer has been registered since the refused ACK (`latest !== sent`) and otherwise rejoins; (b) the binder admits an ACK of any established receipt of the live view as `stale` (no frame) and reserves `unknown-receipt` for receipts the view never issued, or names the refused `appliedView` in the refusal frame. Record the choice in the owning unit's contract before source execution.

also.wording: Decide the client bound for head-drift re-sends (m1) and for a lost refusal (P2CE3 Task14 item 4): either route typed refusals through `sendConfirmed` or have the consumer rejoin after a bounded wait without confirmation or refusal.

`connectStoredCampaignSyncTransport` returns `null` when an existing transport's `campaignId` differs from the supplied `expectedCampaignId`; bind at every creator in the same change, or the mounted surface detaches from the entry panel's transport.

majorM1.finding: **M1. Superseded-ACK refusal tears down a live view** (section 4). Contract-level, inherited from P2CE3's admission rule plus the Task 13/P2CF1 refusal wording; P2CF1 is conformant. Owner decision required: option (a) in this PR or P2CF2, or option (b) in Task 14; in all cases before `applicationReceipts` is composed. Recorded as a hard Task 14 precondition in CF7.
majorM1.resolutionOptionsIntro: Resolution options, owner's call, to be closed before Task 14 activation:
majorM1.optionA: (a) Client rule in the transport leaf (this PR or P2CF2's transport touch, three lines + one test): *"On `campaign-application-unknown-receipt`, if a newer offer has been registered since the refused ACK was sent (`latest !== sent`), the refusal concerns a superseded ACK: ignore it and let `drain` ACK the latest offer; otherwise end the view as recovery-required. Never re-send on unknown-receipt."* This keeps "never retried with the same frame" and "rejoin when the refusal concerns the current ACK"; it requires a one-sentence amendment of the P2CF1 behaviour text at closure.
majorM1.optionB: (b) Server rule in Task 14 (binder leaf): *"Admit an ACK naming any receipt of the live view's established chain; for a receipt older than `latest` return `stale` and send nothing (cumulative commit already covers it). Reserve `unknown-receipt` for receipts the view never issued."* Or: *"Typed refusal frames carry the refused `appliedView` so the client can discard refusals of superseded ACKs."*
majorM1.either: Either way, P2CF2's consumer must treat every `onError` recovery-required as an automatic, idempotent rejoin (CF2), so the cost of M1 is bounded until it is fixed.
majorM1.p2ce3OptionalItem5Correction: My own P2CE3 optional item 5 ("never a server-side timing race") was too strong: it holds for ACKs the client sends after receiving Y, not for an ACK already in flight when Y is established. I correct it here.
majorM1.correctionNote: This corrects evidence/p2ce3-review-20261016.json successorNotes.Task13Optional (its "never a server-side timing race" sentence). That receipt is not edited; this note supersedes the item for any ACK already in flight when the next offer is established.

minors.wording: **m1. No client-side bound on head-drift re-sends** (P8). Each cycle is gated by a server refusal after three commit attempts, so it is not a tight loop, and a visible new offer ends it; but a hidden-only tail under sustained churn re-sends indefinitely. Decide a bound or rely on the Task 14 "bound its wait and rejoin" wording (P2CE3 Task14 item 4).

**m2. Untested branch: `socket.send` throwing inside the re-send** -> `recover('send-failed')` (author concern 4; probe P5 confirms the behaviour). Worth one registered case the next time the transport leaf is open.

**m3. Re-send has no `socket.readyState !== 1` guard**, unlike `drain`. On a CLOSING socket browsers discard silently; `onclose` then marks the transport closed, so no incorrect state results. Cosmetic consistency.

**m4. Held-fact equality is byte equality** (`JSON.stringify`), so a re-sent fact with a different payload key order is refused on a non-replacement bundle (F1). Fail-closed and only reachable on a non-replacement rebaseline, which `registerOffer` does not admit on a live connection; a reconnect uses `replacement`. Record in CF3 so P2CF2 never relies on the non-replacement path for a new view.

**m5. The fold does not check the snapshot's `campaignId` on non-replacement adoption** (F3; pre-existing P2CD). Guarded by the mirror store and by `registerOffer` (`prefix-conflict` on a foreign `event.campaignId`); the host fold path in the component relies on the transport. No change needed in P2CF1; note for P2CF2's consumer gate (`transport.campaignId === campaignId`).

**m6. A confirmation of `sent` is dropped when a newer offer is already registered** (P3; pre-existing P2CD filter, now also leaves `confirmed` false). Harmless for the re-send rule (the same condition blocks the re-send), but the consumer never hears that confirmation and must rely on cumulative semantics (CF4).

notes.wording: **N1.** Amend the P2CF1 behaviour text at closure to the eleven-reason wording in section 7 and to mention `foldCampaignHydration`'s signature `(fold, snapshot, hydrationFacts, replacement?, resumeSequence?)` and the mirror's fourth positional argument.

**N2.** `report.md` concern 2 says "a duplicate ACK is harmless". True for a duplicate of the latest ACK (`stale`, no frame); not true for a duplicate of a superseded ACK (M1). The author's concern 5 (lost refusal, Task 14) is correctly deferred.

**N3.** The mirror state now always has a `launchFacts` key (value `undefined` for legacy mirrors). The fold return shape is pinned by `Object.keys`; the store state shape is not. Zero impact on callers; mention in CF5 so P2CF2 does not persist the key.
**N4.** INTERNAL_ERROR `campaign-application-*` frames are not treated as refusals; the server closes right after. P2CF2 must handle `onclose` as a rejoin signal as well (CF2).
**N5.** Transport `max-lines` warning is pre-existing (636 physical at base, 669 at head). P2CF2 should not touch the transport; if Task 14 does, register an extraction as P2CE2 did for the binder.
